name: THMY
recent: THMY 于2026年11月20日提议私募最多10%新股，同时公布季度业绩，净利同比大幅增长。过去一个月，EPF 持续申报股权变动。
notable: 最多发行10%新股予第三方投资者。
季度净利同比大幅增长，录得 RM11.59 million。
上半年净利同比增长162.6%至 RM17.8 million。
risks: 私募最多10%新股可能摊薄现有股东持股。
EPF 在近期多次申报股权变动。
earnings: 最新季度（2026-06-30）营收 RM20.23 million，净利 RM6.22 million，净利率30.7%；营收环比增17.1%，净利环比增39.4%。

recent_en: THMY proposed a private placement of up to 10% new shares on 20 Nov 2026 and reported quarterly earnings with a sharp year-on-year profit increase. EPF has been filing changes in its shareholdings over the past month.
notable_en: Proposed private placement of up to 10% new shares to third-party investors.
Quarterly net profit rose sharply year-on-year to RM11.59 million.
1H net profit grew 162.6% year-on-year to RM17.8 million.
risks_en: The private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
EPF has filed multiple changes in shareholdings recently.
earnings_en: Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue was RM20.23 million with net profit of RM6.22 million, a net margin of 30.7%; revenue rose 17.1% QoQ and net profit rose 39.4% QoQ.
